description: This Java class defines the ShareAccountDividendDetails entity, representing dividend details related to a share account in the Fineract financial platform. It includes fields such as account ID, amount, status, transaction ID, and a relationship to dividend payout details.

classes.name: ShareAccountDividendDetails
classes.description: JPA entity representing dividend details for a share account, including fields for account ID, dividend amount, status, and associated dividend payout details.

methods.name: ShareAccountDividendDetails
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a new ShareAccountDividendDetails instance with account ID, amount, and dividend payout details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method to update the dividend status and associated savings transaction ID.
